title: How to create a custom AI chatbot with Zapier Chatbots
summary: Zapier gives you the ability to create custom web pages and apps that can also pull in the power of GPT with a chatbot component. Learn how to create your own.
body_markdown: You can also interact with an AI system using a prompt in[AI by Zapier](https://zapier.com/blog/ai-by-zapier-guide/) ,[Copilot](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-copilot-guide/) ,[Tables](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-tables-guide/) , and[Canvas](https://zapier.com/blog/zapier-canvas-guide/) . For tips on writing effective prompts in Chatbots and other Zapier products, read our[prompting help guide](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/36532133250317-How-to-prompt-AI-in-Zapier-products) .
